security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:* blob:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Narrow a video down to a target timespan.
bundle.longDescription: Whittle isolates a segment of a video through an iterative, binary-search-like workflow: preview, mark a cut point, discard everything before or after it, zoom in, repeat. Trims are lossless stream copies.
